title: Kestrel and the Archive
author: Rosalind Dravenmoor
blurb: Juniper Marchetti, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
